At wrap-up, agents see a summary (Add to notes) and a suggested outcome (Use this outcome); nothing is recorded until they choose. Chats get Summarise, and the customer's history shows past summaries. AI calls use Untapped's own analysis. Turn it on under Conversation AI.

AI scoring for quality: read conversations are scored against your evaluation form. Low scores go to the evaluation queue with the AI's answers and evidence, and a person decides. See Quality → AI scores.

Conversation analytics: topics and the ones rising, customer sentiment by day, how often agents took the suggested outcome, and results by agent, with the conversations behind each figure. Under Supervision → Conversation analytics.

Knowledge base: articles agents search on the desk, which agent assist brings up while the customer talks and the AI coach uses for facts. Chats get Suggest a reply, drafted from the conversation and your articles. Public articles make up your help centre, and published articles can be kept in Untapped's knowledge base for its AI agents.

New in the Marketplace: Deepgram and AssemblyAI transcribe your recordings, with summaries, topics and sentiment for English calls. Google Gemini and Mistral AI join OpenAI and Anthropic as AI models.

Features: a new page near the top of the menu lists everything the platform does, grouped and searchable ("call back missed callers"). Each feature says what it is for and has Open and How to, and ones your plan leaves out are marked.

Updates never restart a server pair's database, and a server that runs releases can no longer be deployed from source by mistake."}
